svg.title: Botanical Luna Moth — fillable paint-by-number page
svg.desc: A luna moth with four broad wings, long trailing hindwing tails, feathery antennae, eyespots, and fern fronds. Full-color library preview; opening the SVG changes paintable regions into a numbered worksheet.
